description: DRAFT (scripts/block-face/draft-type.ts (src/canalRecall/blockFace/typeDraft.ts)) for the review turn. Landlust-Zuid family 1930-1934, 5 storeys, 4.9-6.4 m wide: 51 pands on 5 block faces; median cornice 13.49 m, 2 window columns, wall #5b5242. Pane layout, head kind, cornice kind, crowns and ground variants are NOT measured: see draft.unmeasured.

notes: DRAFTER VERDICT: LOW CONFIDENCE. Galen/Leijnsen/Rijpgracht strips are leaf-covered and blurred (2024-11-21); the wall colour reads lighter and greener than the photo's near-black brick, the front carries an erker plus a single window per storey (the 2-bay count is the erker + window), and the ground is shops. Numbers are medians but the strip is poor evidence.
Draft, not installed. Medians over 51 pands; refused below 8 pands or 3 faces.
